text_block_list.text:
After our training meeting,
I handed over a fan letter that had arrived the other day.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I shall take a look.

The letter mentioned being deeply moved by Mihono Bourbon's perfect running...
and the tremendous effort supporting it.

"Bourbon-san... I won't give up either, I'll do my best.
And one day—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"‘I want to become a strong person, just like you.’
...Just like, me."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
............
...Rapid thermal increase detected in the vicinity of the heart.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It's hot... It's so hot, Master.
choice_data_list: Your heart's burning with motivation, huh.
Your heart's burning with motivation, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master, it is not on the schedule,
but may I go for a run now?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I want to run using this heat as energy.
And so, I ended up going on distance runs together with Mihono Bourbon—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa...
Leg fatigue... confirmed...
choice_data_list: Let's not push it. Shall we head home soon?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
......Master.
May I have just a little more of your time?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The more I run, the more fatigue accumulates, but...
the thermal energy in my chest keeps rising.
For the fired-up Mihono Bourbon, while keeping an eye on her physical condition... I stayed with her right up until curfew!
